title: Robin T NDE 9702
content: When I was 17, I was riding a horse to a parade ground event. As we left the stall, the horse was acting frisky. Within 10 minutes of the ride, he threw me off. This caught me off guard as I felt his back arch. My only thought as I flew through the air was not to get my feet caught. I hit the pavement with my face. I do not recall the impact, but I remember that I was way above my body. There was a light behind me. I did see myself on the ground, but was not concerned. Another rider was screaming and yelling, but I have no idea what she was saying. It seemed like a long time that I was in the tree. I also remember making the decision to not leave and to come back to my body. I wanted badly to go in the Navy. Next thing I know, I am kneeling and holding my mouth wondering if I still had my teeth. I don't remember much else afterwards. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: July 1977 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain. Accident Other: Thrown face first off horse onto the pavement. None of my injuries unbelievably were deathly. Smashed face, broken. How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. It was normal At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? As soon as I left my body until I slammed back into it. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Same Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Same. Not sure if heard anything other than myself Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Behind me. I had a deep sense that if I turned around to the light, I would not be back. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Sort of detached and unconcerned Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to lifes I wanted to go in the Navy. I felt it. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Not sure what to say here. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I fully believe we can leave our bodies if trained to do so. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my lifes Coming back with a face that looked like a sledgehammer when I was 17y years old, makes me realize how shallow I was. I do not have a fear of death, nor do I seek it out. I think I am kinder and the USN became my career for 28 years. I always felt that was my purpose and reason for being on the planet. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Feels like yesterday. Ironically, I can't tell you what I did last week Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Immediately. I remember talking about it within days Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I was 17, I am now 64. It's still real to me. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Like yesterday At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: She reported being "way above my body" and also said "It seemed like a long time that I was in the tree."

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She decided to return because she "wanted badly to go in the Navy" and felt turning toward the light meant she "would not be back."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Thrown face first off a horse onto pavement; "smashed face, broken."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She described being in/at a tree while out of body and a bright light behind her.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with observation of body; bright light behind; decision not to turn toward light and to return; then back in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reported being "in the tree" while out of body and sensing that turning toward the light would prevent returning.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I remember that I was way above my body. There was a light behind me.” / “I had a deep sense that if I turned around to the light, I would not be back.” / “I also remember making the decision to not leave and to come back to my body.”
